text: Men Nulaali ado maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- immorde e Nulaaɓe ɓen si wonaa ko ɓe ɓandunke, ɓe laatinoke ñaamooɓe yahoobe kadi ka luumooji, mi laataaki arano e Nulaaɓe ɓen e ɗum, Men waɗi yoga e mooɗon -onon yimɓe ɓen- yoga jarrabuyee ka ngalu e ka baasal e ka cellal e ñaw sabu ngal luutondiral. E on muññoto e dow ko jarribora ɗon kon Alla yoɓa on e dow muñal mooɗon ngal?! Joomi maaɗa laatike ko O Yi'oowo on muññiiɗo e on mo muññaaki, e on ɗoftiiɗo Mo e on yedduɗo Mo.
